symptom: On public build 90a45426-e375-4c53-cc48-28a73a2817bf, a fresh 390x844 homepage context took 6469 ms to finish one regular vacation tab change and showed aria-busy throughout the transition.
expected_behavior: A tab click keeps the existing verified rail visible immediately and replaces it from a shared prefetched or single bounded discovery request without a serialized refreshing response, delay, and duplicate request.
environment: VII public v876 at https://vii.spaplus.co on 2026-11-12 Asia/Jerusalem, Chrome/Playwright fresh mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x1000 contexts, exact app build header 90a45426-e375-4c53-cc48-28a73a2817bf.

steps: Open the homepage in a fresh mobile browser context.
Wait for the vacation period tabs to render.
Select חמישי עד שבת, then immediately select שישי עד ראשון.
Measure click until aria-busy is no longer true and record matching discovery requests.
reproduction.evidence: .qa-output/v876-tab-stall-repro.json records 6469 ms and two sequential friday-weekend API responses of 2508 ms and 2551 ms separated by client recovery.

observations.observation: The first friday-weekend response was HTTP 200 but unverified, no-store and represented a refreshing state.
The browser then issued the same URL again and received the verified response.
The retained rail remained present while busy during slow transitions.
observations.evidence: .qa-output/v876-tab-stall-repro.json immediate state for the 6469 ms transition: loading false, rail true, busy true.

hypotheses.mechanism: A cold durable key returns refreshing before the lease-owned warm operation completes, and client recovery serializes a delay plus the duplicate request.
hypotheses.prediction: The same URL appears twice, first no-store and then verified, while total time approximates both requests plus recovery delay.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Correlate click timing with all matching API requests in a fresh context.
hypotheses.result: Observed 2508 ms refreshing response, 1250 ms recovery delay, 2551 ms verified response and 6469 ms total.

hypotheses.mechanism: Image decoding or rail animation consumes the missing seconds after the API is ready.
hypotheses.prediction: The API finishes once and quickly, while click-to-settle remains slow with image or layout activity.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare JSON completion and the immediate retained-rail state against panel settle time.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: two slow JSON requests consumed the transition; the rail already existed and no skeleton was present.

hypotheses.mechanism: Regular period tabs lack reusable in-flight requests and sequential priming.
hypotheses.prediction: Production source coordinates holiday requests but not regular period requests.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare regular and holiday tab request coordination in the exact v876 source.
hypotheses.result: Supported: v876 had holidayPrimeRequests and sequential holiday priming but no period equivalent.

fix.change: Join the D1 lease-owned warm promise for a bounded 3200 ms before returning refreshing, add shared in-flight deduplication for regular period tabs, and prefetch remaining regular periods sequentially with one-at-a-time concurrency.
fix.evidence: 25 focused tests passed, including rapid-selection and cold-recovery suites; the complete vinext production build passed. Public after-evidence remains a release gate.

affected_family: Homepage regular vacation period tabs on mobile
Homepage regular vacation period tabs on desktop
Homepage holiday tabs on mobile and desktop
Retained rail loading and error states

regression_checks.check: Focused regular and holiday tab request coordination
regression_checks.evidence: 25 tests passed across the new guard plus existing cold-recovery, rapid-selection, snapshot and cache-contract suites.

regression_checks.evidence: pnpm build exited 0; vinext, RSC assets, deployment pruning and worker startup budget passed.
